fee_notes: Traditional location: $30,000 (reduced to $24,000 for Eligible Military/501(c)(3)). Non-traditional: $25,000 (reduced to $20,000 for Eligible Military/501(c)(3)). Non-refundable. No fee for renewal or transfer.
raw_excerpt: The Initial Franchise Fee for a single unit Built Custom Burgers restaurant franchise is $30,000. The Initial Franchise fee for a non-traditional restaurant is $25,000.
